KISWAHILI — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #8
====

GRADE: Grade 9
SUBJECT: KISWAHILI
TIME ALLOWED: 45 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 30
EXAM BODY: KJSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. When practising Kusoma 1.2.1 Kusoma kwa Ufahamu Kifungu cha Simulizi, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Avoid reading anything related to Kusoma 1.2.1 Kusoma kwa Ufahamu Kifungu cha Simulizi.
   B. Copy random text without understanding Kusoma 1.2.1 Kusoma kwa Ufahamu Kifungu cha Simulizi.
   C. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Kusoma 1.2.1 Kusoma kwa Ufahamu Kifungu cha Simulizi.
   D. Use insults to “practise” Kusoma 1.2.1 Kusoma kwa Ufahamu Kifungu cha Simulizi.

2. When practising Kusoma 2.2.1 Kusoma kwa Mapana Matini ya kujichagulia, which approach is best? (1 mark)

4. Kinyume cha “refu” ni: (1 mark)
   A. zito
   B. nene
   C. pana
   D. fupi

5. Ni sentensi ipi iliyo sahihi kisarufi? (1 mark)
   A. Mwanafunzi anasoma kitabu.
   B. Kitabu anasoma mwanafunzi kwa.
   C. Mwanafunzi anasoma vitabu mzuri.
   D. Anasoma mwanafunzi kitabu ya.

10. Wingi wa “mtoto” ni: (1 mark)

   B. watoto
